title: ML Platform Engineer
description: We are looking for an ML Platform Engineer to build the self-serve infrastructure that lets our data scientists train, deploy, and monitor models at scale. You will design and operate Kubernetes-based platforms with MLflow for experiment tracking and model serving, and harden CI/CD pipelines so model releases are fast, auditable, and reproducible. You will also manage infrastructure with Terraform, supporting everything from Kubeflow-based training workloads to Airflow-triggered batch inference. This is a Staff-level role where you will set technical direction and mentor engineers across the platform team.
